messages:
mira: quick heads-up — saw a weird p95 jump when we flipped default kernel to flashv3 in ap-southeast-1 for short payloads (payload <= 32 tokens).

alex: ugh. numbers?

mira: p95 went from ~18ms to ~22ms on h100 L40 for the 7B q4h build under steady 200rps. throughput stable but tails got worse.

jon: can you paste the run command you used?

mira: ran our standard bench:```
python perf/bench.py --model redwood/leo-7b-q4h --kernel flashv3 --region ap-southeast-1 --gpu h100 --payload 16 --rps 200 --duration 120
```

tasha: did you compare against triton-vendor kernel and flashv2?

mira: yes — quick snapshot (median/p95/ms):
```
h100 flashv2   9 / 18
h100 flashv3  10 / 22
h100 triton    11 / 19
```

alex: interesting — flashv3 improved median slightly but p95 regressed vs triton. could be packing or small-batch kernel overhead.

jon: region-specific? any cpu or nic differences in apac vs eu-west?

mira: only difference is boot image and kernel module versions (CUDA 12.2 vs 12.1); i'll repro in eu-west later today.

perf-bot: scheduled job #9843: perf/bench.py --model redwood/leo-7b-q4h --kernel=triton --region=eu-west-1 --gpu=h100 --payload=16 --rps=200 --duration=120 (ETA 14:03 UTC) :white_check_mark:

tasha: long-term, we may want adaptive routing: route small payloads to triton when p95 delta > 10% and keep flashv3 for large seq/batch cases.

alex: +1. propose a simple switch heuristic for rollout: switch_to_flashv3 if (p95_flashv3 <= p95_baseline*1.07) AND (throughput_flashv3 >= throughput_baseline*0.95) AND (median_flashv3 <= median_baseline*1.02). Otherwise prefer triton for that region/gpu/payload cell.

jon: can we derive cells automatically? i.e., group by (region, gpu_type, payload_bucket) and compute stats. then publish kernel_map.

mira: that's what I was thinking. i'll push a probe that computes p50/p95/throughput for these cells every 6h and writes to the kernel-decisions store.

tasha: don't forget quantization quality checks — we saw small output drift when switching kernels in q4h earlier. need to tie eval regressions to kernel choice: if eval_score_drop > 1% then fail fast.

alex: also add hysteresis: require 2 consecutive probe windows where flashv3 meets thresholds before switching. prevents flip-flop during noisy windows.

mira: plan for today: 1) perf-bot run finished in eu-west (thanks) 2) run manual flashv2 vs flashv3 vs triton sweep across payloads [8,16,32,128] 3) collect traces for any p95 > baseline*1.1 4) post results in this thread.

mira: quick note on instrumentation — add KV-cache occupancy to bench output (we suspect small payloads are suffering from cache thrash with new kernel). sample output:```
{"payload":16, "kernel":"flashv3", "p50":10, "p95":22, "kv_cache_mb":512, "batch_size_p95":1}
```

jon: if kv_cache is the culprit, we could add a kernel-specific warmup path: for requests with small seq and cold cache, route through triton for first N requests, then flashv3 after warmup.

alex: ops impact? routing complexity increases but SLA for interactive apps matters more than a tiny median.

tasha: agreed. we'll prototype in staging with routing flag. also add a quality check step: run our golden prompts eval (50 prompts) after any kernel candidate change. abort if bleu/emd drops > 1.5%.

mira: perf-bot results pasted (eu-west):
```
# eu-west h100 payload 16 rps200
flashv2   median=9 p95=17 throughput=195
flashv3   median=10 p95=21 throughput=197
triton    median=11 p95=18 throughput=190
```

mira: preliminary takeaway — flashv3 improves median for long sequences but introduces tail for short ones in apac/eu. not universal but consistent on h100 L40.

jon: ok next steps: (a) mira run the full sweep and upload csv to /mnt/bench-results/kernel-sweep-2638001234.csv (b) tasha spin up staging routing flag (c) alex write rollout policy PR with hysteresis and eval gating.

alex: i'll draft the PR. include the exact math from above and default cell map entries that keep triton for payload<=32 in ap-southeast-1 until we get 48h of stable probes.

mira: uploading csv now. link: https://redwood.s3/bench/kernel-sweep-2638001234.csv

tasha: thanks — let's reconvene if any probe shows eval drop or p95 > baseline*1.1 after routing change. :thumbsup:

mira: will post final sweep summary here. thanks all.
